Alphayo Otieno’s Portfolio

Founded in September 2026 by Alphayo Otieno, with a vision of making practical learning accessible and helping learners build skills for the future.

OUR FOUNDER

Alphayo Otieno

Amazing Scholar Computer School was founded by Alphayo Otieno in September 2026. The school was established with a commitment to making practical, relevant learning more accessible and helping learners build skills they can apply in education, work and everyday life.

Alphayo holds a Bachelor of Education (Science), First Class Honours from Africa International University. He is currently pursuing a Master of Education in Education Leadership and Policy Studies at Daystar University.

At Amazing Scholar, our focus is to help learners learn, practise and create through structured instruction and hands-on skill development.

Administrator sign in

Issue university enrollment keys

Create controlled registration keys for a specific intake and programme. Keys can have a usage limit and expiry date. Share keys only with intended applicants.

Enrollment key register

Administrative audit trail

A chronological record of key issuance, registrations and selected administrative actions. For production, audit records must be written and protected on the server.

Record student fees

Set the total fee payable, then record each payment under its correct fee item. Students will see an itemised statement and the exact outstanding balance.

Semester bookings & tutor allocation

Eight-semester programmes: six units per semester. Assign a tutor to every unit; the academic timetable is generated from these allocations.

Eight-semester academic structure

Each semester runs for 3–4 months and carries six units (48 units across the programme). Recommended academic year mapping: Semesters 1–2 First Year, 3–4 Second Year, 5–6 Third Year, 7–8 Fourth Year.

Select a programme and semester above to load the six official units.

Generate synchronized class timetable

Each unit receives a three-hour weekly class. The generator distributes classes Monday–Friday and prevents same-year cohort clashes and tutor double-booking. It creates schedules for First, Second, Third and Fourth Year from configured unit bookings.

Practicum applications

Review placements, record practicum outcomes and approve completion.

Graduation applications & document dispatch

Review eligibility, approve graduation, issue the award record, and prepare transcript and degree PDFs for manual emailing to each student.
